Australia Launches UN Security Council Seat Campaign

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has officially launched the country's campaign for a two-year term on the United Nations Security Council. The campaign aims to leverage Australia's international reputation. Albanese also plans to address artificial intelligence at the UN.
